literal.prompt: В каком году прекратил существование СССР?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The official Presidential Library page says the Belovezh agreement was signed on 8 December 1991 and that its preamble stated the USSR ceased to exist (Belozh L44,L47-L48). The other numeric choices each denote a different, officially recorded event: first USSR Congress began in May 1989 (Supreme Soviet L57), Gorbachev was elected General Secretary in 1985 (Gorbachev L50), and the Russian Constitution was adopted by popular vote in 1993 (Constitution L47). Thus 1991 uniquely answers the prompt; all four labels are years.
literalGroups.locator: USSR dissolution: raw/prlib-belozha-agreement.json, /originalRecord/payload/output/1/text, L44,L47-L48; 1989 first Congress: raw/prlib-supreme-soviet-first-congress-1989.json, same pointer, L57; 1985 General Secretary: raw/prlib-gorbachev-1985.json, same pointer, L50; 1993 Constitution: raw/prlib-constitution-1993.json, same pointer, L47.

literalGroups.literal: СССР прекратил существование в декабре 1991 года. 8 декабря Россия, Беларусь и Украина подписали соглашение о создании СНГ, в преамбуле которого констатировалось прекращение существования Союза ССР.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library records the December 1991 Belovezh agreement as marking the end of the USSR and quotes its preamble stating that the USSR ceased to exist as an international-law subject and geopolitical reality. The signatories were Russia, Belarus, and Ukraine (Belozh L44,L47-L48).

literalGroups.literal: В 1989 году прошёл первый Съезд народных депутатов СССР.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library archival description says the first Congress of People’s Deputies of the USSR began work in May 1989 (Supreme Soviet L57).

literalGroups.literal: В 1985 году Михаил Горбачёв стал генеральным секретарём ЦК КПСС.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library biography says Gorbachev was officially elected General Secretary of the CPSU Central Committee at the March 1985 plenum (Gorbachev L50).

literalGroups.literal: В 1993 году была принята действующая Конституция России.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Presidential Library page records that the Russian Constitution was adopted by popular vote on 12 December 1993 (Constitution L47).
